flipInputs.label: OI-weighted, 12 expiries, 2-17 DTE, naive dealer convention (long calls, short puts)

method.dealerSignNote: Dealers assumed long every call and short every put (SqueezeMetrics convention). Modeled, not observed: vendors disagree and Cboe's tagged 0DTE data found market-maker flow close to balanced.

units.gex: $ change in dealer delta notional per 1% move in spot
units.vanna: $ change in dealer delta notional per +1 implied-vol point
units.charm: $ change in dealer delta notional over one day (or to settlement inside a day), spot and vol unchanged
units.vomma: $ change in dealer vega (per vol point) per +1 implied-vol point
units.zomma: $ change in GEX (per 1% move) per +1 implied-vol point
